title: Chess Worker operations
description: The routes the Worker answers; every other path under /games/retro/chess is a static asset.

entities.name: Open the game
entities.description: The game's page, for players who are signed in.
entities.authorization: Signed in to icelander.net with the games:play role (requirePlayer → AUTH.requireRole).
entities.result: The page from the static assets, marked Cache-Control: private, no-cache.
failures: Signed out: a redirect to the host's /auth/sign-in, which comes back to the same address.
Signed in without the role: 403 Not allowed.

entities.name: Fetch the engine
entities.description: Godot's WebAssembly engine, joined from its parts.
entities.authorization: None.
entities.result: index.wasm.0, .1, … streamed as one application/wasm, cached for an hour, with Content-Length when every part gave one.
failures: No parts: 404.

entities.name: Sign in
entities.description: Sends the player to icelander.net's one sign-in.
entities.authorization: None.
entities.result: 302 to the host's /auth/sign-in?return=PATH; a return path outside the game becomes the game's front page.

entities.name: Sign out
entities.description: Signs the player out of icelander.net/games.
entities.authorization: The library's sign-out: same origin only.
entities.result: { ok: true } and the site_session cookie cleared; a desktop build's stand-in token gets { ok: true } and nothing else.
failures: From another origin: 403 { code: "forbidden" }.

entities.name: Development sign-in
entities.description: Signs in as any address, for testing two players on one machine.
entities.authorization: Only when DEV_LOGIN is "1", and the library answers only on a local host.
entities.result: A stand-in session cookie and a redirect back into the game, or { token } with format=token.
failures: DEV_LOGIN not "1": 404.

entities.name: Who am I
entities.description: The signed-in player and the sign-in methods on offer.
entities.authorization: None: answers signed out too.
entities.result: { user: { id, email, name, avatar } or null, providers }: google and github when the login service is configured, dev when DEV_LOGIN is "1". Makes or refreshes the player's users row.

entities.name: The lobby
entities.description: Everything the Friends screen shows.
entities.authorization: Signed in to icelander.net (currentUser through the login service); the games:play role is not checked.
entities.result: { incoming, outgoing, active, contacts }: open invitations to and from the player (50 each), online games in play (50), contacts with records (500).
failures: Not signed in: 401 { error: "Sign in first." }.

entities.name: Invite by email
entities.description: An invitation to an address, with the challenger's colour.
entities.authorization: Signed in to icelander.net (currentUser through the login service); the games:play role is not checked. Same-origin JSON only.
entities.result: { challenge, emailed, link }: the open invitation, whether Resend accepted the email, and the link ?challenge=ID.
failures: Not an address, or the player's own: 400.
No colour of white, black or random: 400.
30 invitations in the past hour: 429.
Not signed in: 401 { error: "Sign in first." }.
A POST that is not JSON, or whose Origin is another site: 403 { error: "forbidden" }.

entities.name: Look at an invitation
entities.description: One invitation, to its sender or addressee.
entities.authorization: Signed in to icelander.net (currentUser through the login service); the games:play role is not checked. Only the sender or the addressee.
entities.result: { challenge } in any status.
failures: No such invitation: 404.
Someone else's: 403 "This challenge was sent to someone else."
Not signed in: 401 { error: "Sign in first." }.

entities.name: Accept an invitation
entities.description: Starts the online game.
entities.authorization: Signed in to icelander.net (currentUser through the login service); the games:play role is not checked. Only the addressee (by email address). Same-origin JSON only.
entities.result: { game }: a new online game in play with its start entry, colours from the invitation (random drawn now); each player becomes the other's contact.
failures: Already answered: 409.
Not the addressee: 403, or 404 for the sender.
No such invitation: 404.
Not signed in: 401 { error: "Sign in first." }.
A POST that is not JSON, or whose Origin is another site: 403 { error: "forbidden" }.

entities.name: Decline an invitation
entities.description: Turns it down.
entities.authorization: Signed in to icelander.net (currentUser through the login service); the games:play role is not checked. Only the addressee. Same-origin JSON only.
entities.result: { ok: true }; the invitation is declined.
failures: Already answered: 409.
Not the addressee: 403 or 404.
Not signed in: 401 { error: "Sign in first." }.
A POST that is not JSON, or whose Origin is another site: 403 { error: "forbidden" }.

entities.name: Cancel an invitation
entities.description: The sender withdraws it.
entities.authorization: Signed in to icelander.net (currentUser through the login service); the games:play role is not checked. Only the sender. Same-origin JSON only.
entities.result: { ok: true }; the invitation is cancelled.
failures: Already answered: 409.
Not the sender: 403 or 404.
Not signed in: 401 { error: "Sign in first." }.
A POST that is not JSON, or whose Origin is another site: 403 { error: "forbidden" }.

entities.name: Games with a player
entities.description: A player's details and every online game between the two.
entities.authorization: Signed in to icelander.net (currentUser through the login service); the games:play role is not checked. Any player's id; only games the caller played are listed.
entities.result: { contact: { id, email, name, avatar }, games }: up to 200 games, in play or finished, newest first.
failures: No such player: 404.
Not signed in: 401 { error: "Sign in first." }.

entities.name: Remove a contact
entities.description: Takes someone off the player's contacts.
entities.authorization: Signed in to icelander.net (currentUser through the login service); the games:play role is not checked. Same-origin JSON only.
entities.result: { contacts }: the list without them; the games stay.
failures: Not an address: 400.
Not signed in: 401 { error: "Sign in first." }.
A POST that is not JSON, or whose Origin is another site: 403 { error: "forbidden" }.

entities.name: A profile picture
entities.description: A player's picture, from this origin.
entities.authorization: Signed in to icelander.net (currentUser through the login service); the games:play role is not checked.
entities.result: The image (PNG, JPEG or WebP) fetched from Google's or GitHub's image host at 128 px, cached for a day.
failures: No picture, a host other than the two, or anything but a PNG, JPEG or WebP from it: 404.
The host cannot be reached: the fetch throws, and index.ts answers 500 { error: "Something went wrong on the server." }.
Not signed in: 401 { error: "Sign in first." }.

entities.name: Finished games
entities.description: The player's finished games, online and against the computer.
entities.authorization: Signed in to icelander.net (currentUser through the login service); the games:play role is not checked.
entities.result: { games }: 30 finished games updated before T (or now), newest first, without transcripts.
failures: Not signed in: 401 { error: "Sign in first." }.

entities.name: One game
entities.description: A game with its whole transcript.
entities.authorization: Signed in to icelander.net (currentUser through the login service); the games:play role is not checked. Only its players.
entities.result: { game }: the GameView with every event.
failures: Not a game id, no such game, or not the caller's: 404 "No such game."
Not signed in: 401 { error: "Sign in first." }.

entities.name: Act in an online game
entities.description: A move, a message, a draw offer or answer, or resigning.
entities.transport: POST /games/retro/chess/api/games/{id}/action Action, passed to the game's GameRoom as POST /action with X-User and X-Game
entities.authorization: Signed in to icelander.net (currentUser through the login service); the games:play role is not checked. Only the game's two players, and only in an online game. Same-origin JSON only.
entities.result: { game } after the action, which is also sent to both players' live connections.
failures: A malformed action: 400 "bad action".
No such game: 404.
Not a player, or a game against the computer: 403.
Not the player's turn, a stale ply, an illegal move, no offer to answer, an empty message, or the game is over: 409 with the error and the game.
The game changed between loading and saving: 409 "The board changed; try again." with the current game.
Not signed in: 401 { error: "Sign in first." }.
A POST that is not JSON, or whose Origin is another site: 403 { error: "forbidden" }.

entities.name: Watch a game live
entities.description: A WebSocket that receives the whole game after every change.
entities.transport: GET /games/retro/chess/api/games/{id}/live (WebSocket), passed to the game's GameRoom as /live
entities.authorization: Signed in to icelander.net (currentUser through the login service); the games:play role is not checked. Only the game's two players.
entities.result: 101: the socket gets { t: "state", game } now and after every action; "ping" is answered with { t: "pong" }.
failures: Not a WebSocket upgrade: 426.
No such game, or not a player: 403 "Not your game".
Not signed in: 401 { error: "Sign in first." }.

entities.name: Keep a game against the computer
entities.description: A finished game against Stockfish, into the player's history.
entities.transport: POST /games/retro/chess/api/games/computer { level, color, moves, times, resigned }
entities.authorization: Signed in to icelander.net (currentUser through the login service); the games:play role is not checked. Same-origin JSON only.
entities.result: { game }: stored finished, with a transcript built from the moves and their times (rising, at most 30 days back, never after now), and a resign entry when the player resigned.
failures: Level not 1–8, colour not white or black, or a malformed move list: 400.
An illegal move: 422.
Not over and not resigned: 422 "The game isn't over."
Not signed in: 401 { error: "Sign in first." }.
A POST that is not JSON, or whose Origin is another site: 403 { error: "forbidden" }.
